before.title: MON-5 synthetic customer sign-in boundary

responsibilities.LP-6d: Verify persisted builder issuer credentials and distinct customer session authority.
responsibilities.LP-11: Bind every read to one tenant/job/customer/current party revision.
responsibilities.LP-12: Keep tables/helpers private and EXECUTE limited to the identity login.

gaps: PostgreSQL and browser CI execution and independent Claude RED review remain required.

target.note: Synthetic foundation authorized by Ben on 29 October; this entry records capability, not an independent review.

before.downstream: Three synthetic identity-only entrypoints issue, consume/resolve/sign out, and revoke customer sign-in grants. The two app tables and three helpers remain private to jobguard_migration. Owner/finance membership, current party binding, ten-minute grant lifetime and one-hour customer session cap are checked in SQL. No commercial customer action or shadow read is granted.

after.title: MON-5 synthetic customer sign-in boundary

responsibilities.LP-6d: Verify persisted builder issuer credentials and distinct customer session authority.
responsibilities.LP-11: Bind every read to one tenant/job/customer/current party revision.
responsibilities.LP-12: Keep tables/helpers private and EXECUTE limited to the identity login.

gaps: PostgreSQL and browser CI execution and independent Claude RED review remain required.

target.note: Synthetic foundation authorized by Ben on 29 October; this entry records capability, not an independent review.

after.downstream: Three synthetic identity-only entrypoints issue, consume/resolve/sign out, and revoke customer sign-in grants. The two app tables and three helpers remain private to jobguard_migration. Owner/finance membership, current party binding, ten-minute grant lifetime and one-hour customer session cap are checked in SQL. No commercial customer action or shadow read is granted. M5-MESSAGE adds identity-only customer_portal_message, rechecking the same session around the existing SV-7A intake. Its owner-only source helper permits customer messages only, retains the synthetic issuer sponsor and records separate customer-session audit provenance. It grants no diary or other command authority.
